tasks.label: 0 - Review Workspace
tasks.detail: Generates jobadvaisor.code-workspace: this checkout plus every worktree as folders, with the pull-request inbox (see AGENTS.md)

tasks.label: link .env and local.env
tasks.detail: In a worktree, symlink the main checkout's local.env (settings) and its .env (secrets without a Keychain), if one exists; never copies or prints them
tasks.command: main=$(git worktree list --porcelain | awk '/^worktree /{print $2; exit}'); for name in .env local.env; do if [ -e "$name" ]; then echo "$name present"; elif [ -n "$main" ] && [ "$main" != "$(pwd)" ] && [ -e "$main/$name" ]; then ln -sfn "$main/$name" "$name" && echo "symlinked $name -> $main/$name"; elif [ "$name" = local.env ]; then echo "MISSING $name: create it from .env.example (no source file found to link)"; fi; done

tasks.label: git: enable pre-commit hook
tasks.detail: Points git at .githooks so commits on main are blocked (once per clone, see AGENTS.md)
tasks.command: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo "core.hooksPath=$(git config --get core.hooksPath)"

tasks.label: backend: install browser (playwright)
tasks.detail: Chromium for the rendered-fetch step of intake
tasks.command: uv run --directory backend playwright install chromium

tasks.label: frontend: build
tasks.detail: Builds frontend/dist, which the backend serves at /

tasks.label: demo: fresh data copy
tasks.detail: Stop the demo backend first. Replaces ~/.jobadvaisor/demo-data with a fresh copy of fixtures/demo-persona and deletes its runs and index in ~/.jobadvaisor/demo-state
tasks.command: mkdir -p "$HOME/.jobadvaisor" && rm -rf "$HOME/.jobadvaisor/demo-data" "$HOME/.jobadvaisor/demo-state" && cp -R fixtures/demo-persona "$HOME/.jobadvaisor/demo-data" && echo "fresh demo data at $HOME/.jobadvaisor/demo-data, no runs"
